name: changelog-01
title: Changelog 01 - A Dated Record Of What Changed, Grouped By Release
description: A record of what changed, grouped by release or by date: a version, a moment, a summary, and records carrying one of five kinds, a line about what changed, an optional body and an optional link. The five kinds map to five tones that are a reading order rather than a severity scale, so security takes the warning tone and not the destructive one, because severity is the reader's judgement. A release with no records draws no list. Every string is passed in as a prop.
